text: Kiara passed her driving test this morning, second attempt. She's already asking to borrow her mum's car for the weekend.

Delroy retires on 19 December after 31 years at the depot. His leaving do is that Friday at the Crown, and his daughter Joy is coming down from Inverness to surprise him. He keeps saying he'll be bored within a week, but he's already got a shed full of plans. Need to sort a card and get everyone to sign it.
Felix has his Grade 5 piano exam on 14/11. He said he's been practising every night but his scales still fall apart under pressure.
Coffee with Dorota. She's starting a new role as practice manager at the dental surgery on 3rd of January. Sounds thrilled to be leaving the call centre.
Ali's daughter Mia starts reception in September 2027. They've put down three schools and are waiting to hear back on 16 April.
Remind me to text Zainab on Thursday to see how her viva went. She was really anxious about the external examiner.
Pedro got the promotion! Senior engineer from 1 December 2026. His wife Sara is planning a little dinner for him that weekend.

Emeka mentioned his son Isaac is sitting his GCSEs next summer and is already stressed about maths. Emeka tutored chemistry for years, so he's helping with that side, but he admits he's useless at algebra. Isaac's mock exams are the week of 12 January and his teacher has already flagged him as borderline for the higher paper. Emeka asked if I knew any decent tutors.
Georgia's graduation is on 22 July at the Usher Hall. Her parents are flying in from Toronto for it.
Chen called. He didn't get the job at the bank, but they said he was a close second and to apply again in March 2027.
Elif is doing the Grade 8 violin audition for the youth orchestra on 9th of February. She's very calm about it, unlike her dad.

Freya said her brother Jonah got into Durham to study history. Results came through yesterday. He'd been convinced he'd missed the grades after the English paper went badly in June, so it was a huge relief. He moves into halls on 20 September and Freya is driving him down with their dad.
I should send Vikram a good luck message before his bar exam on 25 November. He's barely slept this month.

Efua's twins started nursery today. She sounded a bit lost with the house so quiet. She's going back to work three days a week from 4 November, the first time since they were born, and she's worried she's forgotten how to do her job. I said I'd meet her for lunch in her first week.
Lunch with Kasia. She's leaving the council at the end of January 2027 to go freelance as a translator. She speaks Polish, German and Portuguese, which I didn't know.
Emre has his citizenship test on 30/10. Wants to borrow my copy of the Life in the UK book.
Rana's interview at Great Ormond Street is on the 4th of December. Paediatric nurse role. She's been wanting this since she qualified.
Natasha and Connor are both graduating on 12 December 2026, same ceremony, different degrees. Their mum is beside herself.
Need to pick up the dry cleaning before Saturday and book the MOT for 18 November.
Ana mentioned her dog Biscuit has been off his food since the move. Vet on Monday.
Eilidh passed her theory test! Practical is booked for 6 March 2027. Must remember to ask her how the lessons are going in a few weeks.
Simone's last day at the library is 28 November. She's been there since 2004 and doesn't want a fuss, so maybe just flowers from the book club.

Petra is nervous about her first day at the new firm on Monday. Big step up from the agency, and her new boss has a reputation for being very demanding. She's also the only woman on the team, which she's trying not to think about. Don't forget to message her on Sunday night to say she'll be brilliant.

Joy's son Hamza got his A-level results: A*, A, B. He's off to Leeds for engineering in September. Joy is throwing a party for him on 30 August at their house, and apparently the whole street is invited. He wants a decent laptop for uni, so maybe we could chip in with his aunt Rana.
Aaliyah said she wants to retake her driving test before Christmas. Her instructor thinks 17 December is realistic.
Delroy's granddaughter had her first day at secondary school this week. He showed me about forty photos of her in the blazer.
Talked to Zainab about her PhD. She submits on 31 March 2027 and her supervisor, Dr Banerjee, is retiring straight after, so there's real pressure to finish on time.
Kiara's sister Freya has a dance audition for the Royal Ballet School on 15/01. Kiara says she cries at every rehearsal. Remind me to send Freya a card the week before.
Mrs Johnson, the deputy head, is retiring in July 2027. Ali is applying for her job.
Felix is allergic to nuts, so no flapjacks for his birthday tea on the 2nd of November.
Message from Vikram: he passed! Called to the bar in February 2027. I need to send congratulations properly, not just a thumbs up.
Georgia's dad, Mr Williams, had his retirement party on Saturday. I couldn't go. I should ask Georgia how it went and whether he's settling into it.
Chen and his partner Elif have both just started new jobs, him at the hospital and her at the university, so they're juggling childcare until their son starts school in September.
Isaac is learning Japanese for fun and wants to sit the JLPT N5 in July 2027. He's also really into bouldering lately.
The school play is cancelled because of the flooding. Efua's daughter was meant to be Mary. Gutted for her.
Emeka Ibrahim, Em to everyone at work, starts as head of finance on 5 January. Promotion was announced on Friday.
Pick up the photo prints for Mum's frame. Also check whether the passport renewal has come through.
Rana's brother Hamza failed his driving test again, third time. She says he's taking it hard and won't talk about it. I should give him a call this weekend, but gently.
Sara is a primary teacher in Leith, Year 2. She loves gardening and is trying to grow chillies on her windowsill.

Natasha has been offered a place on the graduate scheme at Rolls-Royce, starting 7 September 2027. She has to accept by 30 November. Her mum wants her to take it; Natasha isn't sure she wants to move to Derby. She asked if I'd look over the offer letter before she decides, so I need to do that this week.
Kasia's husband, Pedro Schmidt, is a structural engineer. Their cat Pierogi is apparently famous on the street.
Joy mentioned she's dropping hints to her husband about a proper fountain pen for her 50th on 3rd of June. Worth remembering in case he asks me.

Ana's daughter has her driving test next Thursday at 9am. Ana is more nervous than she is. Her daughter has failed once already, in July, because of a roundabout, and has been practising that same junction every evening since. If she passes, Ana has promised her the old Fiesta. I'll text Ana on Thursday afternoon to find out.
Simone's nephew Connor has just started his apprenticeship as an electrician. He's loving it so far.
Jonah had his wisdom teeth out on Monday and missed his mock exam on Tuesday. He's resitting it on 21/11. Remind me to check in with him over the weekend.
Nothing much from the parents' evening. Teacher seemed fine with everything.

Hamza's results day was a disaster, apparently. Joy says he's been in his room since and doesn't want to talk about resits. I should drop round on Saturday with some food for them and see how he's doing.
Aaliyah got the head of year job! Starts after half term. Her old boss, Mr MacDonald, put in a good word for her.
Dorota's son Ali starts university in Glasgow on 14 September 2027. She's already worrying about the cost of halls.
Booked my own Spanish B1 exam for 13 May 2027. Revision starts properly in January.
Petra's daughter lost her first tooth last night and the tooth fairy apparently left a £2 coin, which has set a dangerous precedent in the playground.
Don't forget to get a card for Mia's graduation. Ceremony is 10 July and she's been hinting she'd love a voucher for the bookshop on Thistle Street.
Vikram said his mum is having her knee operation on 8 December and he's taking two weeks off to look after her. I'm covering his shifts on the 9th and 10th.
Elif was offered the lab manager post but turned it down; she's staying put until her contract ends in August 2027. Her boss is apparently furious.
Chen's daughter Eilidh is doing her Highers this year and wants to study medicine at Aberdeen. She's predicted straight As and volunteers at the care home every Saturday morning.
Isaac's swimming gala on the 23rd of November has been called off, pool's closed for repairs. He's doing a 5k fun run on 30 November instead.
Felix Kumar, our new neighbour, works nights at the sorting office. Seems nice. Has a huge Alsatian called Bear.

Call with Georgia. She's three weeks into the new job in Manchester and finding it lonely; doesn't know anyone yet and the team is mostly remote. Her flatmate, Simone, moves out on 1 December, so she'll be on her own. I said I'd visit in January. Must book train tickets before prices go up, and send her a text on Friday just to see how the week went.

Delroy and his wife Dorota are celebrating forty years married on 2 November 2026, the same weekend their grandson Emre graduates from Edinburgh Napier. Big week for them. Remind me to get something for both, maybe a joint card plus a bottle of the whisky Delroy likes.

Kiara is sitting her final accountancy exam on 14 March 2027, then hoping to qualify by the summer. Her firm pays a bonus on qualifying, and she's already earmarked it for a deposit on a flat with her boyfriend.
